intro.title: Puzzle 1
intro.body:
An AI assistant will be available to help you for this round. This is your only chance to use it in this study.
You MUST send the assistant 5+ messages while you play. You will not be able to finish the round otherwise.

intro.title: Puzzles 2 and 3
intro.body: Two more puzzles, back to back. There is no AI assistant for either, and you will not need to fill out the AI assistant questionnaire afterward.
